channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Saiba quais itens vão ficar de fora do tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: President Donald Trump signed a decree on July 15, 2026, imposing 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, while exempting meat and coffee from the measures. The tariffs followed the conclusion of a Section 301 investigation into Brazil’s trade practices, including allegations of unfair advantages for Pix and restrictions on ethanol market access. The Lula government called the tariffs unfair and removed Pix from negotiations, despite not sending officials to prior public hearings.

item.title: Governo Lula encara novo tarifaço dos EUA, mais difícil de derrubar
item.description: The Lula government faces a new U.S. tariff hike, imposing a 25% surtax on Brazilian goods under Section 301 of the 1974 Trade Act, which is seen as harder to reverse due to its strong legal foundation and political backing from Brazil’s opposition linked to the White House ahead of the 2026 elections. This differs from the 2025 tariff, which was struck down by the U.S. Supreme Court for relying on the emergency IEEPA authority. Only 21% of Brazil’s exports to the U.S. are exposed to the new tariff, with 54% already exempt and additional portions subject to separate Section 232 duties on steel, aluminum and automobiles.

item.title: Flávio diz que não viu vídeo de Michelle: "Não tenho relação com ela"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he has no relationship with Michelle Bolsonaro after she published a video criticizing him, saying he did not watch it to avoid being 'contaminated'. He emphasized that his mission comes directly from former President Jair Bolsonaro and said the door remains open for Michelle to join his presidential campaign, despite their current estrangement.

item.title: Expulso e reintegrado ao DC, Aldo Rebelo mantém pré-campanha à Presidência: 'situação está judicializada'
item.description: Aldo Rebelo, expelled and later reinstated in the Christian Democracy (DC) party, says his pre-presidential campaign continues as the party's candidate decision remains judicially determined. He criticized party president João Caldas for attempting to replace him with Joaquim Barbosa, noting Barbosa has not confirmed candidacy and that polls show weak performance for all DC pre-candidates. Rebelo stated he is touring the country in pre-campaign and insists the candidate must be chosen at the party convention between July 20 and August 5.

item.title: EUA confirmam novo tarifaço de 25% sobre produtos brasileiros
item.description: The U.S. imposed a new 25% tariff on Brazilian exports, excluding meat and coffee, following a Section 301 investigation that cited unfair trade practices, including policies favoring Pix. The measure, anticipated by the Lula government, comes amid ongoing trade tensions that previously included reciprocal 10% tariffs in April 2025. Brazil is considering a retaliatory response, while figures like Flávio Bolsonaro attended hearings as observers.

item.title: EUA confirmam novo tarifaço de 25% contra o Brasil
item.description: The United States imposed a new 25% tariff on Brazilian products, concluding a year-long trade investigation. The Lula government views the measure as unjustified and is seeking to expand exemptions, particularly for meat and coffee, while evaluating countermeasures such as the 2025 Economic Reciprocity Law.

item.title: Trump cumpre ameaça e impõe tarifa de 25% a produtos brasileiros
item.description: The United States imposed a 25% tariff on approximately 4,000 Brazilian products, with an estimated impact of $14.9 billion on Brazilian exports to the U.S. The measure, based on Section 301 of the 1974 Trade Act, accuses Brazil of unfair practices in areas such as digital trade, ethanol, intellectual property, and illegal deforestation, including criticism of Pix and the Central Bank. The Lula government calls the decision technically unfounded and politically motivated, despite the U.S. maintaining a trade surplus with Brazil.

item.title: Temer diz que carta de Bolsonaro pode levar à perda da prisão domiciliar
item.description: Former President Michel Temer stated that a letter authored by Jair Bolsonaro and read by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro during a live stream may have violated the conditions of Bolsonaro's house arrest, potentially leading to its revocation. Temer suggested the letter’s content could constitute a breach of judicial restrictions imposed in the ongoing investigations against the former president.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que 'não tem relação' com Michelle e não vai pressioná-la por apoio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that he has no relationship with former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro and will not pressure her to support his 2026 presidential pre-candidacy. He sought to distance his campaign from any familial or symbolic pressure.

item.title: “Lei da Reciprocidade não deve ser usada agora”, diz Nelsinho Trad
item.description: Senator Nelsinho Trad (PSD-MS) said the Economic Reciprocity Law should not be immediately activated in response to a potential 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian products, even as the Lula government views its revival as probable. He advocated for diplomacy and dialogue as the first response to minimize economic harm, acknowledging the law’s legitimacy but warning that immediate use could worsen bilateral trade tensions.

item.title: Equipe de Flávio busca laudo sobre foto com Sicário de Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's legal team is preparing a technical report to challenge the authenticity of a photo showing him alongside Luiz Phillipe Machado de Moraes Mourão, alleged to be the 'hitman' of Daniel Vorcaro, claiming the image is a composite of two distinct photographs, not AI-generated. The strategy aims to counter the political damage caused by the image, which adversaries are using on social media, while also arguing that in 2022, Bolsonaro routinely took photos with many people without public knowledge of the man's alleged ties to Vorcaro.

item.title: Flávio defende Valdemar e critica STF por bloqueio de R$ 119 mi
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro defended Valdemar Costa Neto after Minister Flávio Dino blocked R$119 million, asserting the legality of budget amendment allocations and accusing the STF of political persecution against right-wing legislators. He also criticized restrictions imposed on former President Jair Bolsonaro by Minister Alexandre de Moraes, calling them part of a strategy to hinder legal defense and family contact.

item.title: ‘Hoje em dia não tenho relação com ela’, dia Flávio Bolsonaro sobre Michelle
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he no longer has any relationship with former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, saying he did not watch the video in which she accused him of humiliating her. He denied pressuring her to support his presidential campaign but said his doors are open to anyone who wishes to join, including her. The rift intensified after Michelle revealed in June recordings that Flávio had been rude and disrespectful toward her, urging her to stay out of party decisions.

item.title: “Kassab não pegou a emenda de ninguém”, diz Nelsinho Trad
item.description: Nelsinho Trad, president of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, stated that PSD national president Gilberto Kassab did not participate in the distribution of leadership amendments, arguing that such funds belong to individual parliamentarians. He said the party will provide clarifications to the STF but denied any involvement by PSD leadership in the allocation of amendments, defending that Kassab 'did not take anyone’s amendment'.

item.title: Flávio diz que ignorou vídeo de Michelle “para não se contaminar”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) said he avoided watching a video in which former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro criticizes him, to 'not get contaminated'. He also denied having any ties with her and commented on the production of the film Dark Horse during an interview on the Flow Podcast.

item.title: Republicanos suspende filiação do “prefeito tiktoker” de Sorocaba
item.description: The Republicans party preliminarily suspended the affiliation of Sorocaba's mayor, Rodrigo Manga, for party disloyalty after he posted videos in front of the União Brasil headquarters, where his wife, Sirlange Manga — a federal deputy candidate — is featured. He has five days to present his defense before a final decision on possible expulsion. Manga stated he continues to support his wife’s candidacy, saying she represents the continuity of Sorocaba’s economic and social progress.

item.title: Durigan pede endurecimento de regras para bets a Fachin
item.description: Finance Minister Dário Durigan met with STF President Luiz Edson Fachin to advocate for stricter regulations on betting sites, calling for tighter advertising rules and loss controls. He cited government actions such as blocking 56,000 illegal platforms, authorizing 85 operators, and recording nearly 1 million self-exclusions, alongside PF operations targeting criminal use of municipally licensed betting sites. Durigan reaffirmed the Lula administration’s commitment to permanent rigor in betting regulation, while noting the meeting did not address the Senate’s budget-impacting 'pauta-bomba'.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que não viu vídeo de Michelle e diz que não tem relação com ex-primeira-dama
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he has no relationship with former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro, after she released videos accusing him of disrespect and humiliation during a phone call. He denied pressuring her to support his presidential pre-candidacy, saying her support was optional. The conflict stems from a dispute over the PL’s electoral slate in Ceará, with Michelle having resigned from PL Women’s leadership and considering not running for Senate in the Federal District.

item.title: Sóstenes questiona foto de Flávio com ‘Sicário’: “E se isso não for IA?”
item.description: PL party leader in the Chamber of Deputies, Sóstenes Cavalcante, questioned the authenticity of a photo published by ICL Notícias showing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro alongside Luiz Phillipi Machado de Moraes Mourão, known as 'Sicário'. Even if the image is real, he argued it does not prove any illegality or criminal connection. The statement, given to Metrópoles, reflects the party’s effort to counter narratives linking Bolsonaro allies to controversial figures.

item.title: Alcolumbre adia promulgação de PEC a pedido de Lula
item.description: Senator Davi Alcolumbre postponed the promulgation of the PEC establishing special retirement for community health agents and endemic disease combat workers, following a request from the Lula government. The measure was approved by the Senate on January 14, and Alcolumbre decided to wait for a meeting with the president before publishing it.

item.title: Senado aprova proposta que reduz em quase 40% de floresta no Pará e dificulta multas ambientais
item.description: The Senate approved a bill reducing the Jamanxim National Forest in Pará by 37,39% (from 1.302 million to 814,600 hectares), converting the excluded area into an Environmental Protection Area (APA), which allows land regularization and economic activities such as cattle ranching and mining under partial restrictions. The bill now awaits presidential sanction and has raised environmental concerns over potential increases in deforestation, land grabbing, and illegal mining in the Amazon.

item.title: O que tem para fazer em Brasília? Confira programação de 15 a 21/7
item.description: Brasília offers a cultural and gastronomic program from July 15 to 21, featuring Noru Sushi’s new hot dishes like stuffed squid and curry octopus robata; the 'Constelações Contemporâneas' art exhibition ends this Friday (July 17) at the Teatro Nacional; and the Flamengo vs. Olímpia match at Mané Garrincha stadium encourages visitors to try the Mercado Mané and the new La Cevicheria by chef Renata Carvalho, specializing in ceviches such as Nikkei Avocado.

item.title: PL volta a atacar no TSE pesquisa eleitoral que mostra Flávio Bolsonaro em desvantagem
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) filed a new action with the TSE challenging an AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll showing Flávio Bolsonaro trailing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, citing technical flaws in the sampling methodology and requesting the poll’s registration be annulled. AtlasIntel rejected the claims, stating it submitted all required documents via the PesqEle system and that any issues stem from the TSE’s own system. The case was randomly assigned to Minister André Mendonça, who is expected to rule similarly to Nunes Marques, who previously suspended another AtlasIntel poll involving Bolsonaro in June.

item.title: Portal publica foto de Flávio ao lado de ‘Sicário’ de Vorcaro; defesa nega encontro
item.description: ICL Notícias published a photo showing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) alongside Luiz Phillipi Machado de Moraes Mourão, known as 'Sicário' and identified by the Federal Police as the head of the private militia of banker Daniel Vorcaro. Flávio Bolsonaro's defense denies any meeting took place. The image sparked controversy by linking the senator to organized crime groups.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro se desliga oficialmente do PL Mulher
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro officially resigned from PL Mulher on April 15, transferring control of the women's sector's social media to the national PL. She had stepped down as president of PL Mulher on June 30 following a public dispute with her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, whom she accused of mistreatment and humiliation. The decision was formalized after a meeting with PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto, who maintains that funding for female leadership in 2026 will be 'even higher,' despite concerns from candidates about reduced financial support.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que ‘hoje em dia não tem relação’ com Michelle e não vai pressioná-la por apoio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he no longer has a relationship with Michelle Bolsonaro and will not pressure her for support in his 2026 presidential bid. He said he did not watch her video accusing him of mistreatment during Ceará election maneuvers, preferring to avoid contamination. He reiterated respect for her as his father's wife and criticized internal right-wing conflict, asserting Brazil's real enemy lies elsewhere.

item.title: ELEIÇÕES 2026: Lula escala Simone Tebet para aproximar Haddad do agronegócio em SP
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is enlisting Senator Simone Tebet to mediate dialogue between Finance Minister Fernando Haddad and the agribusiness sector in São Paulo, aiming to strengthen the government's support base in the country's wealthiest state. The strategy seeks to ease historical tensions between the PT and agribusiness, particularly in a pivotal electoral year for 2026.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro afirma não ter mais relação com Michelle, nem ter assistido a vídeo da ex-primeira dama
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he no longer has any relationship with Michelle Bolsonaro and did not watch the video in which she criticizes him, saying he wants to avoid 'contamination' and remain loyal to President Jair Bolsonaro. He denied the rift was part of a coordinated strategy and said he respects Michelle as his father's wife, keeping the door open for anyone willing to join the campaign. He also explained that the film 'Dark Horse' was made in the U.S. due to fears of legal retaliation from Brazil's Supreme Court and confirmed he helped raise funds with banker Daniel Vorcaro before the latter became involved in a financial fraud scandal.

item.title: Flávio acusa Moraes e Dino de usurpar papel do TSE nas eleições
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro accused Supreme Court ministers Alexandre de Moraes and Flávio Dino of usurping the role of the TSE by creating precedents that would allow the First Chamber of the STF to make electoral decisions belonging to the Superior Electoral Court. He cited the conviction of his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro and the suspension of visits to his father Jair Bolsonaro as examples of political interference, claiming these actions aim to hinder his pre-campaign and harm the former president.

item.title: PL aciona TSE e tenta barrar nova pesquisa AtlasIntel; instituto nega irregularidades
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) has asked the TSE to declare the Atlas/Bloomberg poll of July 1 irregular, citing inconsistencies and missing mandatory technical documentation, particularly regarding territorial and demographic coverage. AtlasIntel denies any wrongdoing, stating that all required files were submitted correctly and on time, and that the issue lies with the TSE system, which failed to display the files in the public registry despite their availability in the restricted area. The institute’s CEO, Andrei Roman, accused the PL of political pressure and affirmed that AtlasIntel will not change its methodology due to any form of coercion.

item.title: Não se sabe se vão alterar o equilíbrio do fio da navalha entre os Poderes
item.description: The STF's involvement in politics has become the main factor influencing the opposition, which lacks leadership, with even Lula acknowledging that the Court affects his popularity. The ban on Flávio Bolsonaro visiting his father, imposed by Alexandre de Moraes, reinforces the perception that the STF takes sides, fueling the sentiment that the Judiciary needs to be checked. The 'STF issue' is emerging as a key electoral banner, especially for Senate candidates, who are being judged by their support for impeaching justices, and could decisively influence the 2026 elections amid an unstable balance of power among the branches.

item.title: PL pede ao TSE regras mais rígidas para divulgação de pesquisas
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) filed a request with the TSE calling for stricter rules on the disclosure of electoral polls, citing alleged irregularities in an AtlasIntel poll showing Lula with 46% voter intention. The party argues that polls should only be released after full methodological documentation is made available and that recruitment via paid social media ads should be considered part of data collection, limited to the declared period in the poll's registration.

item.title: 'Foi a minha tentativa de sensibilizar o cara', diz Flávio Bolsonaro sobre ida aos EUA para tratar de tarifaço com Trump
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president from the PL party, stated that his trip to the U.S. to discuss 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods was an attempt to 'sensitize' Donald Trump, denying it was election-motivated. He said he sought to avoid U.S. trade measures regardless of Brazil's electoral outcome. The USTR hearing concludes this Wednesday (15), with the U.S. evaluating a 12.5% tariff (over forced labor) and a 25% tariff (alleging Brazilian practices that burden U.S. trade).

item.title: Flávio: Caiado, Zema e Flávio se atacarem é um desserviço, não vou me prestar a esse papel
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) advocated for unity within the center-right in the 2026 elections, stating he will not engage in criticizing rivals such as Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) and Romeu Zema (Novo), which he views as a disservice to the political project.

item.title: MDB dribla Lula e abre 486 mil hectares de Jamanxim a fazendas e mineração
item.description: In under ten minutes, the MDB in Congress approved a project that reduces environmental protection over 486,438 hectares of the Jamanxim National Forest in Pará, enabling private land regularization and mining. The proposal entered as an extra agenda item, received urgency, and was symbolically approved, overturning a recent effort by President Lula to withdraw a more restrictive version. The operation was orchestrated since May by MDB lawmakers including Jader Barbalho, José Priante, and Isnaldo Bulhões Jr., and takes place just days before the 2026 party conventions.

item.title: Flávio aumenta carga contra STF e diz que corte quer fazer a vez do TSE e interferir em eleição
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) intensified his criticism of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), accusing justices, particularly Alexandre de Moraes, of attempting to interfere in the 2026 elections by assuming roles that belong to the TSE, without providing evidence.

item.title: Site publica foto que mostra Flávio Bolsonaro ao lado de ‘Sicário’ de Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: ICL Notícias published a photo showing pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro alongside Luiz Phillipi Machado de Moraes Mourão, known as 'Sicário', identified by the Federal Police as the leader of the intimidation and coercion unit of Banco Master. The image, taken in 2022 at a hotel in Rio de Janeiro's southern zone, was verified by five AI detection platforms and deemed authentic. Bolsonaro stated he does not recognize the man in the photo and compared the situation to Deolane Bezerra's visit to the Planalto Palace.

item.title: Após virar a casaca de Bolsonaro para Lula, Soraya Thronicke deve desistir de reeleição ao Senado
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS) is expected to withdraw from her Senate re-election bid in 2026 due to poor polling numbers, stemming from her frequent party switches and perceived political inconsistency, including shifting from Bolsonaro supporter to Lula ally. While her team denied the decision is final, they confirmed ongoing negotiations for her to become the substitute for federal deputy Vander Loubet (PT-MS), both aligned with Lula’s base.

item.title: Irmão de Silas Malafaia será suplente de candidato ao Senado do PL
item.description: State deputy Samuel Malafaia, brother of pastor Silas Malafaia, will be the alternate for Carlos Portinho (PL) in the 2026 Senate race in Rio de Janeiro. The decision follows party pressure and Flávio Bolsonaro’s public endorsement of Portinho, who has served as senator since 2020. Samuel Malafaia, in his fifth term in the Alerj, strengthens the PL’s alliance with the Bolsonarist base in the state.

item.title: Corrida presidencial: qual pesquisa está dando a maior vantagem eleitoral para Lula
item.description: Lula leads the 2026 presidential race with advantages ranging from 6 to 12 points in the first round over Flávio Bolsonaro, depending on the pollster. In potential second-round scenarios, his lead varies between 7 and 8 points, with Lula polling between 45% and 49%. The four main polls (Genial/Quaest, BTG/Nexus and others not detailed) confirm his frontrunner status, despite a 2-point margin of error.

item.title: PT nacional força solução e petistas mineiros se sentem desmoralizados
item.description: The announcement by national GTE coordinator of the PT, federal deputy Jilmar Tatto, that Patrus Ananias had been chosen as the party's candidate for governor of Minas Gerais caused discomfort among local leaders, who felt disrespected for not being consulted. Although they support Patrus, state cadres criticized the lack of dialogue with the state leadership. The Minas Gerais PT and Patrus's office have not officially confirmed the candidacy, awaiting a final decision with President Lula.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: o peso dos escândalos recentes na opinião do eleitor, segundo pesquisa
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll reveals that most Brazilians remain unaware of two recent political episodes: the rift between Michelle Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (51% unaware) and the investigation involving Senator Jaques Wagner (PT) (54% unaware). Among those who saw Michelle Bolsonaro’s video criticizing Flávio, 45% believe she was right to speak out, and 31% consider her statements entirely true. Regarding Wagner’s case, 61% of those informed believe he acted wrongly, and 37% think the scandal could negatively affect Lula’s campaign.

item.title: Trad diz que Vieira irá ao Senado apesar de ausência na Câmara
item.description: Senator Nelsinho Trad (PSD-MS) stated that Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira is expected to attend a Senate session after the parliamentary recess in August, despite failing to appear before a Chamber of Deputies summons. Trad noted Vieira has been invited numerous times before and never absent, making another absence unlikely. The focus is on Vieira explaining his claim that the U.S. designation of CV and PCC as terrorist groups implies a risk of U.S. military action in Brazil — a statement that even prompted a reprimand from President Lula.

item.title: Senado terá semanas de esforço concentrado após o recesso, anuncia Davi
item.description: The Senate will hold two concentrated work weeks in August and September, following the parliamentary recess, to vote on pending proposals, including the PEC to abolish the 6x1 work scale and 57 presidential vetoes, in coordination with the Chamber of Deputies. The announcement was made by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, aiming for greater efficiency and harmony between the legislative houses ahead of the October elections.

item.title: Moraes encaminha à PGR manifestação de Bolsonaro sobre carta divulgada por Flávio
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes forwarded to the Attorney General's Office the defense's manifestation by former President Jair Bolsonaro regarding the dissemination of a letter read by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro on social media. PGR Paulo Gonet has five days to issue an opinion. The case raises questions about the legality of the document's disclosure.

item.title: AtlasIntel culpa sistema do TSE por erro apontado pelo PL
item.description: AtlasIntel claims the alleged flaws in its July 2026 electoral poll, challenged by the PL before the TSE, stem from technical issues in the TSE's own system, not from missing documentation, as all required files were properly submitted to PesqEle. The poll shows Lula (PT) at 46.3% and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 36.6% in the first round, and 47.2% vs. 36.3% in a potential runoff. The PL seeks to invalidate the poll for alleged lack of registration, but AtlasIntel references a similar case with Vox Brasil, where the TSE confirmed the issue was a system display error.

item.title: Após um mês internado, Cacique Raoni tem alta hospitalar
item.description: Indigenous leader Raoni Metuktire, 93, was discharged from a São Paulo hospital after a month-long stay for intestinal obstruction, aspiration pneumonia, and digestive hemorrhages. His release comes ahead of the 2026 Brazilian elections, underscoring his enduring role as a global symbol of Indigenous and environmental advocacy.

item.title: Crusoé: “AtlasIntel não mudará sua técnica por pressão política”
item.description: The CEO of AtlasIntel, Andrei Roman, stated that the PL's request to annul the poll showing Lula ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro was based on a recurring error in the TSE system, citing recent jurisprudence from Paraná. He affirmed that the institute will not alter its methodology due to political pressure, emphasizing the integrity of its research.

item.title: A resposta do AtlasIntel a mais uma ação do PL contra pesquisa que mostra liderança de Lula
item.description: AtlasIntel denied the PL's allegations that it failed to meet legal requirements in publishing a July poll showing Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro by 6.6 points, stating the data was submitted on time and that the issue was a technical glitch in the TSE system, not the poll itself. The PL had previously succeeded in suspending another AtlasIntel poll in June over alleged methodological bias.

item.title: Milei celebra classificação da Argentina para a final da Copa: "Carajo"
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei celebrated on social media Argentina's advancement to the 2026 World Cup final after a 2-1 victory over England, with Lautaro Martínez scoring the winning goal in extra time. He used the exclamation 'Carajo' in an enthusiastic post, highlighting the upcoming final against Spain on July 19. The semifinal was played at Atlanta Stadium in the United States.
